name: box jump down with one leg stabilization
description: Step off a box and land on both feet, then hold the landing on one leg. It builds landing control and strengthens the calves and ankle.
instructions: Stand on a sturdy low box with enough clear landing space in front of you.
Step off and land softly on both feet, bending at the hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Shift your weight onto one leg, lift the other foot slightly and hold your balance for a few seconds.
Set the lifted foot down, return to the box and alternate the supporting leg.
